_comment: The four Elephant Hills / Bush Camp ClosedTours and the ehtms.com package each one is sold from. URLs confirmed by the product owner, 2026-10-07. branch_id 1 = The Bush Camp (Chiang Mai, CNX), branch_id 2 = Elephant Hills (Khao Sok, HKT); package_id picks the tour within a branch. modality_codes null means write the closure to EVERY modality of that tour, which is the right default - a date the camp has closed is closed whichever modality we sell it under.
_supplier_id_note: 53911 is the NUMERIC Travel Compositor supplier id for MOMIRA_TH_EH, confirmed live via GET /suppliers on 2026-10-07. The path /closedtour/{supplierId}/{code} wants this number - passing the human-readable name MOMIRA_TH_EH returns 404 on every tour, which reads like a missing tour rather than a wrong supplier.

tours.name: TBC2 - The Bush Camp 2 Days 1 Night (Chiang Mai)
TBC3 - The Bush Camp 3 Days 2 Nights (Chiang Mai)
EH-JS3 - Jungle Safari 3 Days 2 Nights (Elephant Hills)
Elephant Hills package 8 - CONFIRM THE NAME ON FIRST DRY RUN

_release_days_note: release_days is OUR contractual lead time with the supplier, not anything visible on their website. The scan starts the day AFTER it ends, so 45 -> day 46..365 and 60 -> day 61..365. Dates inside the release period are not ours to sell, so a FULL day there is not a closure worth writing. Confirmed by the product owner 2026-10-07: CNX tours 45 days, HKT tours 60 days.
